data.summary: A single coffee blob rises and splats on the visor, leaving the character recognizable. The cup already holds coffee. The camera pushes into a face close-up, cropping both hands and most of the cup by the ending; two failed scoops and a complete final shrug are not established.

observations.text: The referenced courier holds one white cup beneath a dark coffee sphere. The left hand joins the cup; the cup interior contains a visible brown liquid surface, contradicting the empty-cup requirement.

The blob rises past the mouth toward the forehead as the cup stays beneath it. Cup motion and push-in blend together without two clearly separated catching attempts. The character and spaceship remain coherent.

The blob splats near one eye at about 3.8 s and leaves a localized mark on the visor. He turns his gaze toward camera and smiles; a brief hand gesture is partly visible, but the end crops the hands and nearly all the cup. A complete small shrug and weightless scarf movement are uncertain.
